language.title: Choose your language
language.subtitle: This sets the language for everything, including your Coach. You can change it later in Settings.

personalInfo.title: A little about you
personalInfo.body: We filled in what we could. Please check that everything looks right.

intro.title: Let's get to know you a little better
intro.p1: The next 9 short questions will help us understand what matters to you, what may hold you back, and what kind of approach could suit you.
intro.p2: The more accurately you answer, the better we can tailor your guidance and plan to your life.
intro.p3: There are no right or wrong answers, and you can skip any question.

sections.approach: How do you like to work?

q1.title: Where would you most like to see change?
q1.otherReveal: You can write what matters to you.

q2.title: If one thing improved in your life, what would you want to look different?
q2.helper: One or two sentences are enough. You do not need to know how to get there yet.
q2.secondary: It isn't clear to me yet
examples: feeling more in control of time

q3.title: Where do things stand today?
q3.otherReveal: You can describe it in your own words.

options.takingAction: I am already taking action and want to progress better.
options.notStarted: I know what I want, but I have not started yet.
options.noHowToBegin: I have a direction, but I do not know how to begin.
options.tooManyDirections: I have several directions and do not know which to choose.
options.triedInconsistent: I tried before, but struggled to stay consistent.

q4.title: What kind of help could suit you?

options.clearPlan: A clear plan I know how to follow.
options.smallSteps: Small Steps that are easy to begin.
options.seeProgress: A clear view of my progress.
options.remindersEncouragement: Reminders and encouragement at the right time.
options.supportClose: Support from someone close to me.

q5.title: What usually makes it harder for you to progress?
q5.otherReveal: You can tell us what usually happens.

options.lifeBusy: Life gets busy and other things take priority.
options.noClearPlan: I do not have a clear enough plan.
options.tooMuchAtOnce: I try to change too much at once.
options.hardToSeeProgress: It is hard to feel or see progress.
options.hardToRestart: After a miss, it is hard to get back on track.
options.lackSupport: I lack support from other people.

q6.title: How much room do you realistically have for this right now?
q6.freeTextTitle: Is there anything important the Coach should take into account?
q6.freeTextHelper: For example: work, family, studies, health, or a changing schedule.

options.fewMinutes: A few minutes on most days.
options.shortFewTimes: A short amount of time a few times a week.
options.halfHour: About half an hour on most days.
options.moreWhenNeeded: I can invest more when needed.
options.changesWeekly: It changes a lot from week to week.

q7.title: When you start something new, what do you need first?

options.clarityFirst: To see the whole picture clearly before I begin.
options.actionFirst: To start with something small, and get clear as I go.

q8.title: How much structure actually helps you?

options.detailedStructure: A detailed plan. I want to know what to do and when.
options.lightStructure: A light frame. A direction, and room to decide as I go.
options.firmThenLoose: Firm at the start, looser once it becomes routine.

q9.title: How much of a challenge do you want right now?

options.gentleNow: Something gentle. This is not the season to push.
options.meaningfulPush: A real push, but one I can keep up.
options.hardPush: As demanding as I can take.

completion.title: Great, we have a starting point
completion.body: The Coach already knows a little more about what matters to you, what may get in the way, and how it may be best to begin. You can change or add information later.
completion.titleSkipped: That's completely fine, we can start here
completion.bodySkipped: The Coach will get to know you through the conversation, and together you can decide where to focus.

notifications.title: One last thing
notifications.body: Reminders help you show up when it matters, a gentle nudge at the right moment so your progress doesn't slip. The timing is up to you, and you can turn them off anytime in Settings.
